versions.content:
### 1. About This Platform

**Purple Dots – Unified Benefits Interface (UBI)** (the “Platform”) is operated by Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO), a Central Public Sector Enterprise under administrative control of Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) (referred to in these Terms as “we”, “us”, or “our”). Our website is purpledots.depwd.gov.in. The Platform is accessible at:

**1.1 Seeker app:** seekers-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

**1.2 Provider app:** services-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

**1.3 Aggregator app:** aggregators-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

The Platform connects people who are looking for opportunities, services, or support with individuals and organisations that offer them. It enables users to create profiles, list offerings, discover relevant matches, and make connections. The Platform facilitates discovery and connection only — it does not facilitate financial transactions and is not a marketplace.

The Platform is part of a pilot programme designed to test, learn, and generate knowledge that can be used to deploy these solutions at scale.

By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use (“**Terms**”) and our Privacy Notice. The Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data and forms part of these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

### 2. Definitions

The following terms have the meanings set out below wherever they appear in these Terms.

| **Term** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **“Account”** | The relationship between a User and the Platform, created upon successful registration, which enables login, Profile creation, and use of Platform features. |
| **“Aggregator”** | An organisation that uses the Aggregator app to onboard, manage, and represent groups of Seekers or Providers on the Platform. Aggregators act on behalf of the participants they onboard and are responsible for ensuring those participants have given informed consent before their Personal Data is submitted to the Platform. |
| **“Connection”** | An interaction between a Seeker and a Provider, or between two Providers, initiated by one party and accepted by the other, following which Personal Data is exchanged between them with their consent. A Connection may take different forms — such as applying, enrolling, selecting, shortlisting, offering, or requesting opportunities, services, or support. |
| **“Network Facilitator”** | Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India, the entity that operates and governs the Platform. |
| **“Organisation”** | Any entity, whether registered or unregistered, including companies, government bodies, NGOs, partnerships, or trusts, using the Platform through an authorised representative. |
| **“Personal Data”** | Any data about an individual who is identifiable by or in relation to such data, as defined under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. |
| **“Platform”** | As defined in Section 1 of these Terms. |
| **“Profile”** | The information a User creates and maintains on the Platform, which may include Personal Data and non-personal information such as how they describe themselves, their needs, their offerings, or their services. |
| **“Provider”** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to list and offer opportunities, services, or support of any kind to Seekers. A Provider may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **“Seeker”** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to discover and connect with opportunities, services, or support. A Seeker may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **“User”** | Any individual or Organisation that accesses or uses the Platform, whether or not they have created an Account. Includes Seekers, Providers, and Aggregators. |

### 3. Who Can Use the Platform

#### 3.1 Age

You must be 18 years of age or older to create an Account or Profile. If you are below 18, you may only use the Platform with the active involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian, who must register and manage the Account on your behalf.

#### 3.2 Persons with disability with Lawful Guardian

Where a person with disability who, despite adequate support, is unable to take legally binding decisions has a lawful guardian under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 or any other law, that guardian may register and manage an Account on their behalf.

#### 3.3 Organisational Users

If you are using the Platform on behalf of an Organisation, you represent and warrant that you are authorised to act on its behalf and to bind it to these Terms.

#### 3.4 Aggregators

If you are registering as an Aggregator, you represent and warrant that you are acting on behalf of an Organisation with the legal capacity to enter into agreements and onboard participants on their behalf, that you are authorised to do so, and that you will not submit any participant's Personal Data to the Platform without that participant's prior informed consent. Aggregator registrations are subject to approval by the Network Facilitator.

#### 3.4A Aggregator coordinators

An Aggregator may designate individuals within their Organisation or network to act on its behalf on the Platform as coordinators. A coordinator is a person authorised by the Aggregator to log in, upload participant data, and manage participant profiles on the Aggregator's behalf. If you are registering as a coordinator linked to an Aggregator, your registration is subject to approval by the Aggregator you are linked to. By approving your registration, the Aggregator accepts responsibility for all actions you take on the Platform, including any Personal Data you submit on their behalf.

#### 3.5 How to create an Account

You may browse publicly available content on the Platform without creating an Account. To create a Profile, initiate or accept Connections, or use the Aggregator dashboard, you must register. Your Account may be created in the following ways:

**3.5.1 Through the app or a QR code:** visit the relevant URL or scan a QR code shared by an Aggregator or the Network Facilitator. You will be asked to enter your contact details and year of birth, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data before an OTP is sent to verify your contact details. Your Account will be activated once OTP verification is complete.

**3.5.2 Through the AI voice bot:** You may initiate a call through numbers shared by us, or be contacted on our behalf. An AI-powered voice assistant will guide you through registration over a phone call. The voice bot will identify itself as an AI-powered voice assistant at the start of the call, explain what Personal Data it will collect and why, tell you how you can delete your Profile, and ask for your verbal confirmation before any data is collected. Your Account will be created in a pending state and activated once you confirm your Profile on the app. Voice bot registration is not available for minors — if you are below 18 or are registering on behalf of a minor, you must use the app.

**3.5.3 Through an Aggregator:** an Aggregator may create a pending Profile on your behalf using information you have provided to them. You will receive a message inviting you to log in and complete your registration. A pending Profile does not constitute an active Account and you are not bound by these Terms until you activate your Account through the app or a voice call. On activation, you will be asked to review your Profile, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data as described in our Privacy Notice before your Account becomes active.

In all cases, before your Account is activated you will have the opportunity to review and correct any information in your Profile. You can also update your Profile at any time after activation from your Account settings. By confirming your Profile, you represent that the information you have provided is true and correct to the best of your knowledge.

#### 3.6 Your Account

You are responsible for keeping your Account credentials secure and for all activity carried out through your Account. If you suspect any unauthorized access, please notify us immediately through the grievance process in Section 11.

### 4. Connections and Visibility

#### 4.1 How you appear on the Platform

Profiles appear as dots on a discovery map. A dot signals what is being sought or provided — not who is seeking or providing. No Personal Data is visible at the dot level. What others see when they hover over your dot depends on whether you are a Seeker or a Provider and is described in our Privacy Notice.

You can search and filter by type of opportunity or service, by location, and by organisation name. Filters are designed to match what you are looking for with what is available — they do not enable you to search for or exclude other Users based on who they are.

#### 4.2 What others can see

**4.2.1 Seekers:** Your skills, needs, preferences, and general location are visible to Providers. Your Personal Data is not visible to anyone before you accept a Connection.

**4.2.2 Providers:** Your Organisation name and information about your offerings — such as type of opportunity or service, coverage area, and availability — are visible to Users on the Platform. Your Personal Data is shared only when you accept a Connection request.

**4.2.3 Aggregators:** Aggregators can see the Profiles of participants they have onboarded. They cannot see Profiles onboarded by other Aggregators and are not visible to Seekers or Providers on the map or in search results.

For full details of what is visible at each stage, see the Privacy Notice.

#### 4.3 How Connections work

A Connection is initiated when one party sends a request to another — a Seeker to a Provider, a Provider to a Seeker, or a Provider to another Provider. Before sending a request you will be shown what Personal Data will be shared if the request is accepted and asked to confirm your consent.

When you receive a Connection request and choose to accept it, you will be asked to confirm that your own Personal Data will be shared with the requesting party before the Connection is completed. A Connection will not be completed without active confirmation from both parties.

Once both parties have confirmed, Personal Data is exchanged so you can make direct contact. This exchange cannot be reversed.

You may cancel a request at any time before it is accepted.

#### 4.4 Connections involving minors

If your Account is registered and managed by a parent or legal guardian, a guardian OTP verification step is required when making or accepting a Connection. Your guardian will receive a one-time password to confirm the action on your behalf before any Connection is completed or Personal Data is shared.

#### 4.5 Notifications

When activity occurs on your Account — such as a new Connection request, an accepted request, or a profile update — you will receive a notification by SMS, WhatsApp, or in-app message. Notifications will tell you that something has happened but will not include Personal Data such as the name or contact details of the other party. You will be directed to log in to the Platform to view the full details.

If a notification needs to include Personal Data for a specific purpose, your separate consent will be sought before it is sent.

### 5. Managing Your Profile and Account

You can edit, pause, or delete your Profile, and update or delete your Account at any time. For full details of each option and what it means for your data, see the the **Profile and Account Management** section at the end of these Terms.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile deletion or Account closure.

### 6. Privacy and Your Personal Data

We take your privacy seriously. Our Privacy Notice explains what Personal Data we collect, why we collect it, who can see it, how long we keep it, and what your rights are — including how to withdraw your consent. The Privacy Notice forms part of these Terms. Please read it before using the Platform: our Privacy Notice.

By using the Platform and providing your information, you agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your Personal Data in accordance with the Privacy Notice.

### 7. Your Responsibilities

#### 7.1 What applies to all Users

All Users must comply with applicable laws while using the Platform. You agree not to misuse the Platform or access it through any means other than those expressly permitted under these Terms. You are solely responsible for any content you provide and for your interactions with other Users, and you must treat all Users with respect, fairness, and in compliance with applicable law. We reserve the right to remove any inaccurate, misleading, or unlawful content from the Platform without prior notice. By registering on the Platform you acknowledge that you have read and agree to comply with the prohibited content rules set out in Section 7.2.

#### 7.2 What you must not do

Without limiting the above, you must not:

- 7.2.1 use the Platform for any purpose other than the purposes set out in these Terms;

- 7.2.2 post, upload, or distribute any defamatory, libellous, inaccurate, or misleading content;

- 7.2.3 post, upload, or distribute any content that is unlawful or that a reasonable person could deem to be objectionable, offensive, indecent, pornographic, harassing, threatening, vulgar, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive, or that promotes or glorifies self-harm, suicide, or violence;

- 7.2.4 post, upload, or distribute any content that infringes upon any third party rights including intellectual property rights, any other legal rights of any individual or organisation, or applicable law;

- 7.2.5 post, upload, or distribute any content that threatens the security, unity, integrity, or sovereignty of India, or that is likely to incite violence or disturb public order;

- 7.2.6 use the Platform in any manner that is harmful to minors, or in any manner that violates these Terms, the Privacy Notice, or any other policies published by the Network Facilitator;

- 7.2.7 impersonate any person or Organisation, falsely claim an affiliation, or access the Accounts of others without permission;

- 7.2.8 misrepresent your qualifications, experience, identity, or eligibility for any opportunity or service on the Platform;

- 7.2.9 make unsolicited offers, advertisements, proposals, or send junk mail or spam to other Users;

- 7.2.10 solicit the login credentials of any other User;

- 7.2.11 defame, harass, abuse, threaten, or defraud Users, or collect or attempt to collect Personal Data about other Users or third parties without their consent;

- 7.2.12 remove, circumvent, disable, damage, or otherwise interfere with security-related features of the Platform;

- 7.2.13 intentionally interfere with or damage the operation of the Platform or any User's usage of it, including by uploading or disseminating viruses, adware, spyware, worms, or other malicious code;

- 7.2.14 deploy bots, scrapers, or automated tools (including AI-based tools) to extract, generate, or manipulate content in a misleading, deceptive, or harmful way;

- 7.2.15 submit, upload, or share any synthetically generated information — including deepfakes, AI-generated or AI-altered images, or cloned audio — that misrepresents a real person or event or that could mislead other Users about your identity or qualifications;

- 7.2.16 communicate false or misleading information about the origin of a communication, or impersonate the Platform or any official communication channel.

#### 7.3 Additional responsibilities of Seekers

- 7.3.1 ensure that all supporting documents you submit are accurate and current;

- 7.3.2 not misrepresent your qualifications, experience, skills, or eligibility for any opportunity or service;

- 7.3.3 share documents or information only as necessary for the purpose of making or accepting a Connection;

- 7.3.4 respond to Connections in good faith — if you are no longer available or interested, update your Profile or delete your Account;

- 7.3.5 not discriminate against any Provider based on caste, religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law; and

- 7.3.6 use contact details received through a Connection only for the purpose for which the Connection was made.

When you initiate or accept a Connection, you consent to your name, phone number, and email address being shared with the other party. You acknowledge that such Personal Data will then be handled by that party in accordance with their own privacy practices, and that the Network Facilitator is not responsible for how they use or safeguard your Personal Data once it has been shared.

#### 7.4 Additional responsibilities of Providers

If you are a Provider, you agree to:

- 7.4.1 ensure that all information you submit — including your Organisation details, listings, offerings, and supporting documents — is accurate, up to date, and not misleading. Remove or update any listing that is no longer available, expired, or no longer accurately describes what you offer;

- 7.4.2 ensure that all opportunities, services, and support you list on the Platform are genuine, lawfully offered, and compliant with applicable laws including labour, consumer protection, anti-discrimination, disability, and sector-specific regulations;

- 7.4.3 respond to Connection requests within a reasonable time. If you are unable to accept a request, decline it promptly so the other party can pursue other opportunities;

- 7.4.4 where your offering has eligibility requirements — including age, qualification, location, or document requirements — state these clearly in your listing before a Connection is initiated;

- 7.4.5 refrain from discriminating against any User based on caste, religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other status protected under applicable law, including the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. Connections must be based on the relevance of your offering to the other party's needs and qualifications — not on personal characteristics;

- 7.4.6 keep all Personal Data received through the Platform — including contact details shared through a Connection — confidential and use it solely for the purpose for which the Connection was made. Do not share it with any third party without the other party's prior consent;

- 7.4.7 refrain from using Personal Data received through the Platform for any purpose beyond the specific Connection — including marketing, profiling, or any automated decision-making — without the other party's explicit consent;

- 7.4.8 take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Personal Data received through the Platform from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or misuse, in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules framed thereunder. Where you are an Organisation, this includes having a documented data protection policy; and

- 7.4.9 if you become aware of any misuse of Personal Data received through the Platform or any interaction that may have caused harm to another User, report it through the grievance process in Section 11.

#### 7.5 Additional responsibilities of Aggregators

If you are an Aggregator, you agree to:

- **7.5.1 Obtain consent before upload.** Before submitting any participant's Personal Data to the Platform, you must have obtained that participant's informed consent. By submitting Personal Data, you represent and warrant that you hold valid consent from each participant whose data you are uploading, that this consent covers the purposes for which the Platform will use that data, and that you are authorised by the Network Facilitator to onboard participants on this Platform.

- **7.5.2 Maintain consent records.** You must maintain records of the consent obtained from each participant and make these available to the Network Facilitator on request. Consent records must be kept for as long as the participant's Profile remains active and for a reasonable period thereafter.

- **7.5.3 Ensure accuracy.** You are responsible for the accuracy of all Profiles and Personal Data you submit on behalf of participants. Update Profiles promptly when a participant's circumstances change and remove Profiles that are no longer accurate or relevant.

- **7.5.4 Act within your authority.** Only submit Personal Data for participants who have authorised you to act on their behalf. Do not submit data for any person without their knowledge and prior informed consent.

- **7.5.5 Comply with data protection law.** You are a data fiduciary in respect of the participants you onboard and are fully responsible for lawful processing, data minimisation, purpose limitation, and timely deletion in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules framed thereunder.

- **7.5.6 Act on withdrawals promptly.** If a participant withdraws consent or requests deletion, notify the Network Facilitator immediately and take steps to have their Profile deactivated or deleted without delay. Where Personal Data was collected by you solely for the purpose of submitting it to this Platform, you must delete that data from your own systems on withdrawal. Where you hold Personal Data about a participant for other independent purposes under separate consent, your obligations in relation to that data are governed by the terms of that consent and applicable law.

- **7.5.7 Manage exits properly.** On ceasing to act as an Aggregator for any participant, notify the Network Facilitator and ensure the participant is informed of any changes to how their Profile will be managed. Do not retain any participant's Personal Data beyond the period necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.

- 7.5.7 Report misconduct. If you become aware of any misconduct involving a participant you have onboarded, or any misuse of a participant's Personal Data, report it through the grievance process in Section 11 without delay.

- **7.5.8 Coordinator responsibility.** If you have approved coordinators to act on your behalf, you remain fully responsible for their compliance with these Terms and for all Personal Data they submit on your behalf. Ensure coordinators are briefed on their data handling obligations before granting them access.

### 8. Content and Intellectual Property

#### 8.1 Content you submit

You are solely responsible for all content you submit, upload, or share through the Platform. By doing so, you:

- 8.1.1 represent and warrant that you have all necessary rights, licences, and permissions to use and share such content; and

- 8.1.2 grant the Network Facilitator a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, sublicensable, and transferable licence to host, store, reproduce, display, and technically process such content solely for the purpose of operating, maintaining, and improving the Platform.

We do not claim ownership over your content.

#### 8.2 Content moderation

We reserve the right to remove any content or suspend any Account at our discretion, particularly if the content is unlawful, misleading, discriminatory, harmful, or otherwise in violation of these Terms. If you believe any content on the Platform infringes your rights or violates applicable law, please raise a concern through the grievance process in Section 11, with sufficient details for us to evaluate and address your concern. Where we receive actual knowledge that any content on the Platform is unlawful, we will act expeditiously to remove or disable access to it.

Content that sexually exploits minors will be removed within 24 hours of coming to our knowledge and reported to the relevant authorities.

#### 8.3 Our intellectual property

All rights in the Platform — including its software, design, features, and branding such as logos, names, and visual elements — are owned by or licensed to the Network Facilitator and protected under applicable intellectual property laws. You may not copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, display, or otherwise use any of our content, branding, or materials without our prior written consent, unless expressly permitted by a licence. You must not use the Network Facilitator's name, logo, or branding in any manner that suggests endorsement without our prior written permission. Use of the Platform does not grant you any ownership or licence in our intellectual property, except as expressly set out in these Terms.

### 9. Limitation of Liability and Disclaimers

The Platform and all content provided through it are made available on an “as is” and “as available” basis. We do not guarantee the accuracy, timeliness, completeness, performance, or fitness for a particular purpose of the Platform or its content.

You agree to cooperate fully with the Indemnified Parties in defending any such claim. This obligation continues after your Account is closed or your use of the Platform ends.

If you have a concern about the Platform, another User's conduct, or any other matter related to these Terms, please contact our Grievance Officer or submit a concern through the 'Contact support' option in your Account Settings:

| **Email** | sandeepkumar.rth@nic.in |

We will endeavour to acknowledge your complaint within 24 hours of receipt and resolve it within 15 days, in accordance with the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules 2021.

#### 11.2 Data and privacy complaints

If your concern relates to your Personal Data — including a request to access, correct, or delete your data, or a concern about how your Personal Data has been handled — please refer to the grievance process in our Privacy Notice.

### 12. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. We will notify you when fresh terms are published. Your continued use of the Platform after updated Terms are published constitutes your acceptance of those changes. We encourage you to review these Terms periodically.

### 15. Contact Us

If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at support_purpledot@alimco.in.

This page explains your options for managing your Profile and Account. We may update this page as our processes evolve.

#### Your options at a glance

| **Action** | **What it does** | **How to do it** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Edit Profile | Update your information | Profile edit in navigation menu |
| Pause Profile | Hide your Profile temporarily | Profile pause in navigation menu |
| Delete Profile | Remove your Profile permanently | Profile delete in navigation menu |
| Delete Account | Remove your Account permanently | Support request in account settings |

#### Edit your Profile

You can update any information in your Profile at any time by clicking edit in the Profile Menu on the screen. Changes take effect immediately and your updated Profile will be visible to others on the Platform.

#### Pause your Profile

Pausing your Profile temporarily hides it from the Platform. While paused your Profile will not appear in search results or on the discovery map. Your Account remains active and your existing Connections are not affected. You can reactivate your Profile at any time from the Navigation Menu.

#### Delete your Profile

Deleting your Profile permanently removes your listing and associated data from the Platform. Your Profile will no longer be visible immediately once you confirm deletion from the Profile's Action Menu. Deleting your Profile does not delete your Account. You can create a new Profile at any time after deletion.

#### Update your Account

In order to update your Account, you can contact support by submitting a support request form. Once you raise a request, it may take up to 30 working days for the process to complete. You will receive a confirmation on the channel used for the Account, i.e., email or phone as used for registration.

#### Delete your Account

Deleting your Account permanently removes your Profile and Account. You will not be able to log in after your Account is deleted. To re-use the Platform you will need to register again.

To delete your Account, go to account settings and submit a support request.

You will receive a confirmation by SMS or email once this is complete.

#### What happens to your data

Once your deletion request is processed, your Personal Data will be deleted in accordance with the timelines set out in the Privacy Notice.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile or Account deletion.

Questions? Submit a support request using the link above.

This Privacy Notice is published by **Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO)**, a Central Public Sector Enterprise under administrative control of Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), (“we”, “us”, “our”, “Network Facilitator”), the data fiduciary for the Purple Dots Platform. Our website is https://alimco.in/ and the Platform is accessible at:

- Landing page — purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Seeker portal — seekers-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Provider portal — services-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Aggregator portal — aggregators-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Common login after registration — signals-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

This Privacy Notice explains what Personal Data we collect about you, why we collect it, who can see it, how long we keep it, and what your rights are. This Notice forms part of our Terms of Use and should be read alongside them. Defined terms used in this Notice have the meanings given to them in the Terms of Use.

### 1. What This Privacy Notice Covers

The Purple Dots Platform connects persons with disability with organisations and individuals offering relevant services, opportunities, and support.

This Privacy Notice applies to all Personal Data collected through the Platform — whether you registered yourself through the app or by scanning a QR code, called us on a number we shared with you, were contacted by us on your number, or had your information submitted on your behalf by an organisation working with you.

### 2. Who Can Use This Platform

You must be 18 years of age or older to create an Account and Profile on the Platform.

If you are below 18, a parent or legal guardian must register and manage your Account on your behalf. Voice bot registration is not available for minors. If we become aware that Personal Data of a child below 18 has been collected without parental consent, we will delete it as soon as possible. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child's data has been collected without your consent, please contact us through the grievance process in Section 10.

Where a person with disability who, despite adequate support, is unable to take legally binding decisions has a lawful guardian under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 or any other law, that guardian may register and manage an Account on their behalf.

### 3. How your information appears on the Platform

#### 3.1 What is visible on the Platform

The Platform protects your Personal Data through a two-tier visibility model.

**3.1.1 Before a Connection:** Only non-identifying information is visible to others. For Seekers, this includes general information such as skills, preferences, and an approximate location on the map — generated by randomising the address you provide within a distance range to protect your precise whereabouts. Your name, contact details, and exact location are not visible to anyone before you accept a Connection and consent to share your Personal Data.

**3.1.2 After a Connection is accepted:** When both you and the other party have actively confirmed a Connection, your name, phone number, and email address are shared with the other party so you can make direct contact. This will not happen without your consent. This applies whether the Connection is between a Seeker and a Provider, or between two Providers.

3.1.3 Aggregators and their authorised coordinators are not visible to Seekers, Providers, or other Aggregators on the Platform — they do not appear in search results or on the discovery map. Their role is to upload or onboard the Personal Data of Seekers or Providers for whom they hold consent. If you are a Seeker or Provider who was onboarded by an Aggregator, only that Aggregator and their authorised coordinators can see the Profile created on your behalf and whether you have activated your Account.

For full details of what information is visible at each stage and how it is handled, see the data tables in Section 4 below.

### 4. What We Collect and Why

We collect different information depending on how you use the Platform. The tables below set out what we collect and why. Where you register via a QR code, the same information is collected as through the Platform. The QR code directs you to the registration flow — it does not itself collect any data.

#### 4.1 If you are a Seeker

| **Information collected** | **Why we collect it** | **Who can see this** |
| --- | --- | --- |

**6.3 Connections:** to facilitate Connections between Users, including the exchange of contact details when both parties have confirmed their consent.

**6.4 Platform operations and improvement:** to operate, maintain, monitor, and improve the Platform's features, security, and performance.

**6.5 Safety and fraud prevention:** to detect and prevent misuse, fraudulent activity, duplicate accounts, or activity that violates our Terms of Use or this Privacy Notice.

**6.6 Communication:** to contact you with important information about your Account, your Connections, or the operation of the Platform, including follow-up communications by voice call, WhatsApp, or SMS.

**6.7 Programme monitoring and learning:** to generate de-identified and aggregated insights about how the Platform is used, to improve outcomes for participants and inform the broader programme.

**6.8 Legal compliance:** to comply with applicable law, respond to lawful requests from government authorities, or protect the rights, property, and safety of our Users, partners or others.

We will not use your Personal Data for any purpose not described in this Privacy Notice without first informing you and, where required, seeking your consent. Your Personal Data will not be sold, rented, or used for advertising or marketing purposes.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party. We are not able to retrieve or delete this once it has been shared.

### 8. How We Keep Your Personal Data Secure

We take the security of your Personal Data seriously and implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect it. Your data is stored on servers located within India, in a private network environment not directly accessible from the internet. Personal Data is encrypted both when stored and when transmitted. Access to your data is strictly controlled — only authorised personnel can access it, every access is logged, and your Personal Data is never written to application logs.

No system is completely secure. In the event of a Personal Data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights, we will notify you and the relevant authorities in accordance with our obligations under applicable law.

### 9. Your Rights

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, you have the following rights in relation to your Personal Data:

**Right to access and correct your Personal Data —** you can view and update your Personal Data at any time from your account settings.

**Right to erasure —** you can request deletion of your Personal Data. See our the **Profile and Account Management** section of our Terms of Use for details.

**Right to withdraw consent —** you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect anything that happened before you withdrew. See our the **Profile and Account Management** section of our Terms of Use for details.

**Right to grievance redressal —** if you have a concern about how your Personal Data has been handled, contact our Grievance Officer as described in Section 10.

**Right to nominate —** you have the right to nominate another individual to exercise your data rights on your behalf in the event of your death or incapacity. Contact us through the grievance process in Section 10 to make a nomination.

### 10. Grievances and the Data Protection Board

#### 10.1 How to raise a concern about your Personal Data

If you want to exercise your rights in relation to your Personal Data, or have a concern about how your Personal Data has been handled including a concern about a data breach — you can contact our Grievance Officer or submit a concern through the 'Contact Support' option in your Account settings.

We will acknowledge your complaint promptly and aim to resolve it within 60 days.

#### 10.2 The Data Protection Board of India

If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to escalate to the Data Protection Board of India, established under Section 18 of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. The Board's dedicated complaint portal is not yet operational. For updates on when it becomes available and information on how to file a complaint, visit https://www.meity.gov.in/dpdp or https://egazette.gov.in. Once the portal is operational, you may file a complaint directly with the Board.

### 11. Changes to This Privacy Notice

We may update this Privacy Notice from time to time. When we do, we will notify you through the Platform. The date at the top of this Notice tells you when it was last updated.

If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or how we handle your Personal Data, please contact us at support_purpledot@alimco.in.

### 1. About This Platform

**Purple Dots – Unified Benefits Interface (UBI)** (the “Platform”) is operated by Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO), a Central Public Sector Enterprise under administrative control of Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) (referred to in these Terms as “we”, “us”, or “our”). Our website is purpledots.depwd.gov.in. The Platform is accessible at:

**1.1 Seeker app:** seekers-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

**1.2 Provider app:** services-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

**1.3 Aggregator app:** aggregators-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

The Platform connects people who are looking for opportunities, services, or support with individuals and organisations that offer them. It enables users to create profiles, list offerings, discover relevant matches, and make connections. The Platform facilitates discovery and connection only — it does not facilitate financial transactions and is not a marketplace.

The Platform is part of a pilot programme designed to test, learn, and generate knowledge that can be used to deploy these solutions at scale.

By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use (“**Terms**”) and our Privacy Notice. The Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data and forms part of these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

### 2. Definitions

The following terms have the meanings set out below wherever they appear in these Terms.

| **Term** | **Definition** |
| --- | --- |
| **“Account”** | The relationship between a User and the Platform, created upon successful registration, which enables login, Profile creation, and use of Platform features. |
| **“Aggregator”** | An organisation that uses the Aggregator app to onboard, manage, and represent groups of Seekers or Providers on the Platform. Aggregators act on behalf of the participants they onboard and are responsible for ensuring those participants have given informed consent before their Personal Data is submitted to the Platform. |
| **“Connection”** | An interaction between a Seeker and a Provider, or between two Providers, initiated by one party and accepted by the other, following which Personal Data is exchanged between them with their consent. A Connection may take different forms — such as applying, enrolling, selecting, shortlisting, offering, or requesting opportunities, services, or support. |
| **“Network Facilitator”** | Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India, the entity that operates and governs the Platform. |
| **“Organisation”** | Any entity, whether registered or unregistered, including companies, government bodies, NGOs, partnerships, or trusts, using the Platform through an authorised representative. |
| **“Personal Data”** | Any data about an individual who is identifiable by or in relation to such data, as defined under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023. |
| **“Platform”** | As defined in Section 1 of these Terms. |
| **“Profile”** | The information a User creates and maintains on the Platform, which may include Personal Data and non-personal information such as how they describe themselves, their needs, their offerings, or their services. |
| **“Provider”** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to list and offer opportunities, services, or support of any kind to Seekers. A Provider may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **“Seeker”** | A User who creates an Account on the Platform to discover and connect with opportunities, services, or support. A Seeker may be an individual or an Organisation. |
| **“User”** | Any individual or Organisation that accesses or uses the Platform, whether or not they have created an Account. Includes Seekers, Providers, and Aggregators. |

### 3. Who Can Use the Platform

#### 3.1 Age

You must be 18 years of age or older to create an Account or Profile. If you are below 18, you may only use the Platform with the active involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian, who must register and manage the Account on your behalf.

#### 3.2 Persons with disability with Lawful Guardian

Where a person with disability who, despite adequate support, is unable to take legally binding decisions has a lawful guardian under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 or any other law, that guardian may register and manage an Account on their behalf.

#### 3.3 Organisational Users

If you are using the Platform on behalf of an Organisation, you represent and warrant that you are authorised to act on its behalf and to bind it to these Terms.

#### 3.4 Aggregators

If you are registering as an Aggregator, you represent and warrant that you are acting on behalf of an Organisation with the legal capacity to enter into agreements and onboard participants on their behalf, that you are authorised to do so, and that you will not submit any participant's Personal Data to the Platform without that participant's prior informed consent. Aggregator registrations are subject to approval by the Network Facilitator.

#### 3.4A Aggregator coordinators

An Aggregator may designate individuals within their Organisation or network to act on its behalf on the Platform as coordinators. A coordinator is a person authorised by the Aggregator to log in, upload participant data, and manage participant profiles on the Aggregator's behalf. If you are registering as a coordinator linked to an Aggregator, your registration is subject to approval by the Aggregator you are linked to. By approving your registration, the Aggregator accepts responsibility for all actions you take on the Platform, including any Personal Data you submit on their behalf.

#### 3.5 How to create an Account

You may browse publicly available content on the Platform without creating an Account. To create a Profile, initiate or accept Connections, or use the Aggregator dashboard, you must register. Your Account may be created in the following ways:

**3.5.1 Through the app or a QR code:** visit the relevant URL or scan a QR code shared by an Aggregator or the Network Facilitator. You will be asked to enter your contact details and year of birth, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data before an OTP is sent to verify your contact details. Your Account will be activated once OTP verification is complete.

**3.5.2 Through the AI voice bot:** You may initiate a call through numbers shared by us, or be contacted on our behalf. An AI-powered voice assistant will guide you through registration over a phone call. The voice bot will identify itself as an AI-powered voice assistant at the start of the call, explain what Personal Data it will collect and why, tell you how you can delete your Profile, and ask for your verbal confirmation before any data is collected. Your Account will be created in a pending state and activated once you confirm your Profile on the app. Voice bot registration is not available for minors — if you are below 18 or are registering on behalf of a minor, you must use the app.

**3.5.3 Through an Aggregator:** an Aggregator may create a pending Profile on your behalf using information you have provided to them. You will receive a message inviting you to log in and complete your registration. A pending Profile does not constitute an active Account and you are not bound by these Terms until you activate your Account through the app or a voice call. On activation, you will be asked to review your Profile, read and accept these Terms, and consent to the processing of your Personal Data as described in our Privacy Notice before your Account becomes active.

In all cases, before your Account is activated you will have the opportunity to review and correct any information in your Profile. You can also update your Profile at any time after activation from your Account settings. By confirming your Profile, you represent that the information you have provided is true and correct to the best of your knowledge.

#### 3.6 Your Account

You are responsible for keeping your Account credentials secure and for all activity carried out through your Account. If you suspect any unauthorized access, please notify us immediately through the grievance process in Section 11.

### 4. Connections and Visibility

#### 4.1 How you appear on the Platform

Profiles appear as dots on a discovery map. A dot signals what is being sought or provided — not who is seeking or providing. No Personal Data is visible at the dot level. What others see when they hover over your dot depends on whether you are a Seeker or a Provider and is described in our Privacy Notice.

You can search and filter by type of opportunity or service, by location, and by organisation name. Filters are designed to match what you are looking for with what is available — they do not enable you to search for or exclude other Users based on who they are.

#### 4.2 What others can see

**4.2.1 Seekers:** Your skills, needs, preferences, and general location are visible to Providers. Your Personal Data is not visible to anyone before you accept a Connection.

**4.2.2 Providers:** Your Organisation name and information about your offerings — such as type of opportunity or service, coverage area, and availability — are visible to Users on the Platform. Your Personal Data is shared only when you accept a Connection request.

**4.2.3 Aggregators:** Aggregators can see the Profiles of participants they have onboarded. They cannot see Profiles onboarded by other Aggregators and are not visible to Seekers or Providers on the map or in search results.

For full details of what is visible at each stage, see the Privacy Notice.

#### 4.3 How Connections work

A Connection is initiated when one party sends a request to another — a Seeker to a Provider, a Provider to a Seeker, or a Provider to another Provider. Before sending a request you will be shown what Personal Data will be shared if the request is accepted and asked to confirm your consent.

When you receive a Connection request and choose to accept it, you will be asked to confirm that your own Personal Data will be shared with the requesting party before the Connection is completed. A Connection will not be completed without active confirmation from both parties.

Once both parties have confirmed, Personal Data is exchanged so you can make direct contact. This exchange cannot be reversed.

You may cancel a request at any time before it is accepted.

#### 4.4 Connections involving minors

If your Account is registered and managed by a parent or legal guardian, a guardian OTP verification step is required when making or accepting a Connection. Your guardian will receive a one-time password to confirm the action on your behalf before any Connection is completed or Personal Data is shared.

#### 4.5 Notifications

When activity occurs on your Account — such as a new Connection request, an accepted request, or a profile update — you will receive a notification by SMS, WhatsApp, or in-app message. Notifications will tell you that something has happened but will not include Personal Data such as the name or contact details of the other party. You will be directed to log in to the Platform to view the full details.

If a notification needs to include Personal Data for a specific purpose, your separate consent will be sought before it is sent.

### 5. Managing Your Profile and Account

You can edit, pause, or delete your Profile, and update or delete your Account at any time. For full details of each option and what it means for your data, see the the **Profile and Account Management** section at the end of these Terms.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile deletion or Account closure.

### 6. Privacy and Your Personal Data

We take your privacy seriously. Our Privacy Notice explains what Personal Data we collect, why we collect it, who can see it, how long we keep it, and what your rights are — including how to withdraw your consent. The Privacy Notice forms part of these Terms. Please read it before using the Platform: our Privacy Notice.

By using the Platform and providing your information, you agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your Personal Data in accordance with the Privacy Notice.

### 7. Your Responsibilities

#### 7.1 What applies to all Users

All Users must comply with applicable laws while using the Platform. You agree not to misuse the Platform or access it through any means other than those expressly permitted under these Terms. You are solely responsible for any content you provide and for your interactions with other Users, and you must treat all Users with respect, fairness, and in compliance with applicable law. We reserve the right to remove any inaccurate, misleading, or unlawful content from the Platform without prior notice. By registering on the Platform you acknowledge that you have read and agree to comply with the prohibited content rules set out in Section 7.2.

#### 7.2 What you must not do

Without limiting the above, you must not:

- 7.2.1 use the Platform for any purpose other than the purposes set out in these Terms;

- 7.2.2 post, upload, or distribute any defamatory, libellous, inaccurate, or misleading content;

- 7.2.3 post, upload, or distribute any content that is unlawful or that a reasonable person could deem to be objectionable, offensive, indecent, pornographic, harassing, threatening, vulgar, hateful, racially or ethnically offensive, or that promotes or glorifies self-harm, suicide, or violence;

- 7.2.4 post, upload, or distribute any content that infringes upon any third party rights including intellectual property rights, any other legal rights of any individual or organisation, or applicable law;

- 7.2.5 post, upload, or distribute any content that threatens the security, unity, integrity, or sovereignty of India, or that is likely to incite violence or disturb public order;

- 7.2.6 use the Platform in any manner that is harmful to minors, or in any manner that violates these Terms, the Privacy Notice, or any other policies published by the Network Facilitator;

- 7.2.7 impersonate any person or Organisation, falsely claim an affiliation, or access the Accounts of others without permission;

- **7.5.2 Maintain consent records.** You must maintain records of the consent obtained from each participant and make these available to the Network Facilitator on request. Consent records must be kept for as long as the participant's Profile remains active and for a reasonable period thereafter.

- **7.5.4 Act within your authority.** Only submit Personal Data for participants who have authorised you to act on their behalf. Do not submit data for any person without their knowledge and prior informed consent.

- **7.5.5 Comply with data protection law.** You are a data fiduciary in respect of the participants you onboard and are fully responsible for lawful processing, data minimisation, purpose limitation, and timely deletion in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the rules framed thereunder.

- **7.5.6 Act on withdrawals promptly.** If a participant withdraws consent or requests deletion, notify the Network Facilitator immediately and take steps to have their Profile deactivated or deleted without delay. Where Personal Data was collected by you solely for the purpose of submitting it to this Platform, you must delete that data from your own systems on withdrawal. Where you hold Personal Data about a participant for other independent purposes under separate consent, your obligations in relation to that data are governed by the terms of that consent and applicable law.

- **7.5.7 Manage exits properly.** On ceasing to act as an Aggregator for any participant, notify the Network Facilitator and ensure the participant is informed of any changes to how their Profile will be managed. Do not retain any participant's Personal Data beyond the period necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.

- 7.5.7 Report misconduct. If you become aware of any misconduct involving a participant you have onboarded, or any misuse of a participant's Personal Data, report it through the grievance process in Section 11 without delay.

You can update any information in your Profile at any time by clicking edit in the Profile Menu on the screen. Changes take effect immediately and your updated Profile will be visible to others on the Platform.

Pausing your Profile temporarily hides it from the Platform. While paused your Profile will not appear in search results or on the discovery map. Your Account remains active and your existing Connections are not affected. You can reactivate your Profile at any time from the Navigation Menu.

To delete your Account, go to account settings and submit a support request.

You will receive a confirmation by SMS or email once this is complete.

Once your deletion request is processed, your Personal Data will be deleted in accordance with the timelines set out in the Privacy Notice.

Personal Data you have already shared through accepted Connections remains with the other party and is not affected by Profile or Account deletion.

Questions? Submit a support request using the link above.

This Privacy Notice is published by **Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO)**, a Central Public Sector Enterprise under administrative control of Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), (“we”, “us”, “our”, “Network Facilitator”), the data fiduciary for the Purple Dots Platform. Our website is https://alimco.in/ and the Platform is accessible at:

- Landing page — purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Seeker portal — seekers-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Provider portal — services-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Aggregator portal — aggregators-purpledots.depwd.gov.in
- Common login after registration — signals-purpledots.depwd.gov.in

This Privacy Notice explains what Personal Data we collect about you, why we collect it, who can see it, how long we keep it, and what your rights are. This Notice forms part of our Terms of Use and should be read alongside them. Defined terms used in this Notice have the meanings given to them in the Terms of Use.

### 1. What This Privacy Notice Covers

The Purple Dots Platform connects persons with disability with organisations and individuals offering relevant services, opportunities, and support.

This Privacy Notice applies to all Personal Data collected through the Platform — whether you registered yourself through the app or by scanning a QR code, called us on a number we shared with you, were contacted by us on your number, or had your information submitted on your behalf by an organisation working with you.

### 2. Who Can Use This Platform

You must be 18 years of age or older to create an Account and Profile on the Platform.

If you are below 18, a parent or legal guardian must register and manage your Account on your behalf. Voice bot registration is not available for minors. If we become aware that Personal Data of a child below 18 has been collected without parental consent, we will delete it as soon as possible. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child's data has been collected without your consent, please contact us through the grievance process in Section 10.

Where a person with disability who, despite adequate support, is unable to take legally binding decisions has a lawful guardian under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 or any other law, that guardian may register and manage an Account on their behalf.

### 3. How your information appears on the Platform

#### 3.1 What is visible on the Platform

The Platform protects your Personal Data through a two-tier visibility model.

**3.1.1 Before a Connection:** Only non-identifying information is visible to others. For Seekers, this includes general information such as skills, preferences, and an approximate location on the map — generated by randomising the address you provide within a distance range to protect your precise whereabouts. Your name, contact details, and exact location are not visible to anyone before you accept a Connection and consent to share your Personal Data.

**3.1.2 After a Connection is accepted:** When both you and the other party have actively confirmed a Connection, your name, phone number, and email address are shared with the other party so you can make direct contact. This will not happen without your consent. This applies whether the Connection is between a Seeker and a Provider, or between two Providers.

3.1.3 Aggregators and their authorised coordinators are not visible to Seekers, Providers, or other Aggregators on the Platform — they do not appear in search results or on the discovery map. Their role is to upload or onboard the Personal Data of Seekers or Providers for whom they hold consent. If you are a Seeker or Provider who was onboarded by an Aggregator, only that Aggregator and their authorised coordinators can see the Profile created on your behalf and whether you have activated your Account.

For full details of what information is visible at each stage and how it is handled, see the data tables in Section 4 below.

### 4. What We Collect and Why

We collect different information depending on how you use the Platform. The tables below set out what we collect and why. Where you register via a QR code, the same information is collected as through the Platform. The QR code directs you to the registration flow — it does not itself collect any data.

#### 4.1 If you are a Seeker

| **Profile — Who I am** |  |  |

The call will not proceed to data collection without your verbal agreement | Only the Network Facilitator, our authorised voice AI service provider, and authorised partners in compliance of data protection law |

#### 4.2 If you are a Provider

| Service description | To give Seekers and other Users more detail about what you offer | Visible publicly |
| Service catalogue or file upload | To provide additional information about the opportunities, services, or support you offer, if you choose to share it | Visible publicly where uploaded |

Used to create your Profile and for quality monitoring of the programme. | Only the Network Facilitator, our authorised voice AI service provider, and authorised partners in compliance of data protection law |

The call will not proceed to data collection without your verbal agreement | Only the Network Facilitator, our authorised voice AI service provider, and authorised partners in compliance of data protection law |

#### 4.3 If you are an Aggregator

#### 4.4 Cookies and tracking

The Platform uses only functional cookies — specifically, a session cookie to maintain your login and interface preferences. We do not use advertising, tracking, or analytics cookies.

A session cookie is deleted when you close your browser or log out. It does not track you across other websites.

If you prefer not to accept cookies, you can configure your browser to refuse them. Please note that refusing session cookies may affect your ability to log in and use the Platform.

### 5. Who We Share Your Personal Data With
